scope: Frozen local baseline for simulation training, real-to-sim measured-trajectory replay, and staged sim-to-real evaluation. Includes reviewed neck/arm frames, stereo-aligned base and upper-side wrist cameras. Hardware-calibrated dynamics and real policy transfer are not certified by simulation checks.

physics_assumptions.frame_lift: 20 mm square rails/posts; middle section 82.55 x 50.8 mm with 430 mm modeled length; upper section 76.2 x 50.8 mm extends from local z=-430 mm to the shoulder plate underside at +101 mm. Middle travels half the carriage. Solid collision envelopes retain explicit source masses; stage internals and exact tube lengths remain unmeasured.
physics_assumptions.mounts: Measured shoulder flange spacing and heights; supplied full spinal CAD with separate image-calibrated neck and effective right-arm reference. Stock gripper mounts retained. Hardware Home unchanged; head source inertials remain approximate.
physics_assumptions.mass: Retain verified vendor arm/finger inertials and source chassis/lift/housing inertials; accessories are included in assembly mass rather than added again. Model total 42.0053061 kg is an engineering default.
physics_assumptions.contact: Retain finger friction 2.0 and wheel friction 1.2; working grasp baseline is the tested two 25 g parcels. Force, slip, payload and tipping predictions are approximate.
physics_assumptions.left_response: Left arm uses identified per-joint effective kp/kv, with retained masses/inertias/friction and the deployed bridge default 2/30 s interpolation. Development RMSE improves 34.4%; two later-episode test intervals improve 44.4%, every joint improves. Limited to the observed unloaded/open-gripper regime; this is not unique physical motor-parameter identification. Right arm retains kp500/kv20.
physics_assumptions.base: Use source CAD module locations and four ideal simulated encoders. Hardware motor-3 reconstruction is not reproduced as a nominal simulation fault; body velocity from that dataset is not independent ground truth.
physics_assumptions.neck: Use calibrated joint limits/home, CAD head mount and dataset-validated 1/2 rad/s pan/tilt slew limits. Keep the collision guard for bracket interference.
physics_assumptions.camera_timing: Render all simulation cameras at the same physics timestamp. Recorded camera/robot synchronization is approximate; no artificial fitted timestamp offset is introduced.
physics_assumptions.gripper_response: Right opening uses 6 normalized strokes/s after bounded identification on 3 episodes and pooled-error validation on 15 other episodes. Left opening and both closing directions retain 5 strokes/s as prior symmetry assumptions. Only 99 validation samples cover moving opening; improvement is aggregate and not uniform across episodes. Object-constrained closing and physical grip force are not identified.

versioning: Retain this archive unchanged; use a new release version for subsequent geometry, calibration or physics changes.
